name: ont_r10_genomic_v1
description: ONT R10.4.1 genomic/targeted reads around MUC1 (use with 'reads ont --simulator pbsim3-fragments'): strand mix, empirical error channel and strand-aware homopolymer stutter from public WGS reads; no PCR artefacts

provenance.source: Aggregate statistics from the public ONT R10.4.1 WGS runs of ENA PRJEB92208 (ERR15277552, ERR15277553; Madritsch et al. 2025, Sci Rep). No reads or sequences are included. Small sample (tens of VNTR-spanning reads): treat homopolymer spectra as approximate.
provenance.derived_by: MucOneSpan deep review 2026-09-23 read-level profiling; errors and stutter derived and validated with helpers/calibrate_read_profile.py --engine empirical
provenance.fragments_note: Read-length model is a generic targeted/adaptive-sampling default (median 6 kb, sigma 0.5), not fitted to a specific library.
provenance.uncovered_runs: Homopolymer keys with fewer than 300 observations in the targets (for example A/T runs >= 3) have no stutter entry and receive no homopolymer length errors.
